scripts.preview: npm run seo:generate && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare preview
scripts.deploy: npm run cf:build && npm run cf:deploy
scripts.db:claims: wrangler d1 execute michigangaragepros --remote --command "SELECT id, company_name, city, contact_name, email, phone, company_slug, status, created_at FROM claim_requests ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50"
scripts.db:leads: wrangler d1 execute michigangaragepros --remote --command "SELECT id, service, zip, name, phone, email, status, created_at FROM leads ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50"
scripts.db:featured: wrangler d1 execute michigangaragepros --remote --command "SELECT id, company_name, city, plan, contact_name, email, phone, company_slug, status, created_at FROM featured_requests ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50"
